CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Added stdlib/compress/inflate.prn: a real RFC 1951 DEFLATE decompressor (puff.c-style canonical Huffman, all 3 block types). Compiles clean, passes 4/5 real zlib-generated test vectors; one dynamic-Huffman case hangs on a real VS0 codegen bug (isolated via a Python reference port -- algorithm itself verified correct). Not yet wired into SHANKPIT. Commit 1fc82ae (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
